title: Zeb and George Boyd, friendship and death
summary: He recalls the clarinetist Zeb and his friendship with George Boyd, who helped him, when Boyd died in the 1930s, and Kid Howard's kidding.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Yes. Yeah Piku was a yes talking about the old clarinet another one I used to like too. I just know one name they call him Zeb.
Oh yeah I've heard of him.

Zeb he was a good clarinet player too around here. I'm trying to think was he playing with René before George Lurice. I think that's who he used to play with before George Lurice got with René's band. He was playing with Kid René. Well he was good too. Him and George the boy they well now they got a few but I couldn't swear I used to hear them like Lorenzo Teo. He heard of him. Yes. And another one I can't call his name but he was supposed to be great too but I can't swear I heard him. No. No but Zeb and George Boyd well I used to live around the George Boyd house and I used to see him all the times that I knew all about him. We were good friends you know. He always tried to help me on my plane you know whenever he saw me. Yes. He really was good on that. That's why when after he died well I tried to stick around his wife because they were nice to me you see. Sure. Yeah. So I tried to treat her as nice as I could after he died. So I don't know.
About when was that that George Boyd died do you remember?
Um gee it must have been in the late 30s or early 40s. About that time. Yes he'd been dead quite a while.
I thought maybe before I thought it might be 1920s or something.
No no it wasn't in the late 30s because I was playing music and I just started 24. So I think it was the 30s when he died now. Maybe someone could correct me you know because.
Was he sick for a long time?
Well no he wasn't sick long. He was lingering sick. Yeah. He had a two boy you know. Oh he did. Yeah. Yeah. He was lingering sick you know.
Was he playing pretty close to the end or did he quit playing?

No he was playing close to the end. He was. And you know one thing? I never get over that. That same kid Howard used to laugh at that man when he'd cough you know. Kidding. Kid Howard used to. Kid Howard took a me he always was full of fun you know. Yeah. Yeah. He's a terrible thing that kid Howard. I saw him Sunday looking pretty good at the banquet. We were.
